title: What If You Were Sealed in a Fake Spaceship for 520 Days? Six Men Were

scenes.text: What if you were locked in a windowless capsule for 520 days? Six men volunteered.
In 2010 they sealed themselves inside a 550 cubic meter mock spacecraft in Moscow, to rehearse a trip to Mars.
No windows, no sunlight. Even messages from outside arrived on a delay, like real deep space.
Month by month the crew moved less. By the final stretch they were sleeping over half an hour more a day.
Four of six developed sleep problems. One drifted onto a 25-hour day, out of step with the rest.
They walked out in November 2011. The lesson for a real Mars trip: the danger isn't only radiation or rockets. It's sleep.

description:
What if you were sealed in a fake spaceship for 520 days? In the Mars-500 experiment, six men lived in a windowless, hermetically sealed 550 cubic metre capsule at the Institute of Biomedical Problems in Moscow, emerging on 4 November 2011.
Wrist monitors showed the crew grew steadily more sedentary; in the last quarter they slept over half an hour more per day than in the first. Four of the six had sleep problems, one lived on a 25-hour cycle and another was chronically short of sleep (PNAS, 2013).
What should we run through next?
